WITH 
SegmentAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        s.Segment,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.Amount), 0) AS TotalConsumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    JOIN gasstations g ON c.CustomerID = g.CustomerID
    LEFT JOIN transactions t ON y.Date = DATE('2013') AND t.TransactionID = t.TransactionID
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, s.Segment
),
SegmentMinAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Count < 5 THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS MinTotalConsumption,
        MIN(CASE WHEN Count < 5 THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS MinAmount
    FROM SegmentAverage
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AnnualAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(CASE WHEN Sum(Count) > 0 THEN SUM(Count) / SUM(CASE WHEN Sum(Count) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) AS AverageConsumption
    FROM SegmentMinAvg
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
YearMonthQuery AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', Date) AS Year,
        SUM(AverageConsumption) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR) AS AvgConsumption2013
    FROM AnnualAvg
)
SELECT 
    SUM(AvgConsumption2013) AS AnnualAverageConsumption2013
FROM YearMonthQuery
WHERE Year == 2013
AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM "Match" m
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.away_team_api_id = t.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' 
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "Match" m2
    WHERE m2.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m2.away_team_api_id = m.team_fifa_api_id
      AND m2.home_team_api_id = m.team_api_id
      AND m2.away_team_goal > 0
      AND m2.home_team_goal < 0
)
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN m2.away_team_goal > m2.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1

    cs.name as constructor_name,

    constructor_standings cs

    races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId

WITH filtered_posts AS (
    SELECT p.*, COUNT(DISTINCT v.PostId) as link_count
    FROM post_links p
    JOIN posts p ON p.PostId = p.PostId
    LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId = p.PostId
    WHERE YEAR(p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
    AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY p.Id
),
total_links AS (
    SELECT SUM(link_count) as total_link_count
    FROM filtered_posts
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_link_count) as avg_monthly_links
    FROM total_links
)
SELECT avg_monthly_links as average_monthly_links_created_in_2010
FROM monthly_avg

```sql
WITH filtered_posts AS (
    SELECT p.*, COUNT(DISTINCT v.PostId) as link_count
    FROM post_links p
    JOIN posts p ON p.PostId = p.PostId
    LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId = p.PostId
    WHERE YEAR(p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
    AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY p.Id
),
total_links AS (
    SELECT SUM(link_count) as total_link_count
    FROM filtered_posts
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_link_count) as avg_monthly_links
    FROM total_links
)
SELECT avg_monthly_links as average_monthly_links_created_in_2010
FROM monthly_avg;
```
